purpose: Convert repeated successful experiences into verified capabilities without reinforcing unverified mistakes.

metaLearner.question: Which learning loops improve fastest, which repeat the same lesson, and which verified abilities should be promoted to Core?

loops.label: Editorial Loop
loops.nextRequirement: Reach stable first-pass writing pattern success above 85%, then generalize to Creator Desk and Newsletter.
loops.rule: Experience becomes ability only after repeated, verified, generalized success.

loops.label: Runtime Loop
loops.nextRequirement: Verify that adaptive feed/source actions reduce the exact provider-level error rate they target.
loops.rule: Experience becomes ability only after repeated, verified, generalized success.

loops.label: Engineering Loop
loops.nextRequirement: Promote only patch patterns that apply cleanly, verify, and avoid duplicate proposals.
loops.rule: Experience becomes ability only after repeated, verified, generalized success.

loops.label: Knowledge Graph Loop
loops.nextRequirement: Promote recurring entities and relationships only when multiple independent dossiers confirm them.
loops.rule: Experience becomes ability only after repeated, verified, generalized success.

loops.label: Owner Decision Loop
loops.nextRequirement: Learn owner decision heuristics from approved, denied, and completed outcomes without bypassing approval gates.
loops.rule: Experience becomes ability only after repeated, verified, generalized success.

loops.label: News Output Loop
loops.nextRequirement: Use more accepted dossiers to raise output while keeping the Editor strict.
loops.rule: Experience becomes ability only after repeated, verified, generalized success.

offRamp.success: Learning Queue -> Capability Review -> Promotion Gate
offRamp.failure: Repair Queue -> Root Cause -> Retest before learning
offRamp.rule: Nothing becomes Core Knowledge until verification proves the outcome.

separation.experience: Things the Brain has observed, such as articles processed, headline rewrites, feed failures, owner decisions, and patch outcomes.
separation.ability: Things the Brain has demonstrated repeatedly with verification, such as headline generation, source isolation, story dossiers, or structured patches.

rule: The Brain learns in a spiral: observe, experiment, verify, generalize, promote, then reuse across News Lab, Creator Desk, Newsletter, and future applications.
